_about: Online play (game/net_session.gd, addons/tube). trackers: public WebTorrent trackers that pass the join handshake between players (more = more chances one works; dead ones are skipped). stun: servers that tell a player his public address. signaling_timeout_seconds x signaling_attempts = how long a join keeps trying before 'max connection attempts reached'. join_timeout_seconds: a connected player has this long to send his profile before the host lets him go. Checked 2026-11-13 with tools/net_probe.tscn: tracker.openwebtorrent.com passes only the answer's type and sdp (our candidate list is dropped, hence the candidates inside the sdp), tracker.androodev.com passes everything, open.ftorrent.com and tracker.files.fm refuse our requests ('Invalid request': removed).
